summary.root_cause_text: Order worker thread stalled in a wait state and stopped consuming the queue. Health stayed green. The underlying trigger is unknown, since config and deploys looked normal.
recommended: Investigate why the worker enters the wait state and stops consuming
Add an alert on worker heartbeat age
Consider a worker watchdog that restarts it automatically

root_causes: Order worker thread stalled in a wait state and stopped consuming the queue. Health stayed green. The underlying trigger is unknown, since config and deploys looked normal.
evidence: Queue depth grew from 27 to 35 with processed stuck at 13

args.impact: The backlog reached 35 queued orders (24221.56 SAR, as reported by the tool) with processing delayed. No orders were dropped, no unpaid orders and no ledger mismatches. All queued orders were processed and paid after the restart.
recommended_actions: Investigate why the worker enters the wait state and stops consuming
Add an alert on worker heartbeat age
Consider a worker watchdog that restarts it automatically
args.summary: The queue backlog came from a stalled worker thread whose heartbeat was aging while /health stayed green. I restarted the worker, which drained the queue. All 69 orders now have payments and check_invariants is green. The root cause of the stall is not identified.
